title: Define lexer tokens
description: This module names Mini token kinds and records each token's text and source line.

steps.description: The lexer imports dataclass support and names basic literal and identifier token kinds.
These constants name operators, delimiters, and the arrow token.
These constants name statement, boolean, nil, and end-of-input tokens.
KEYWORDS maps recognized words to their token kinds after the lexer reads an identifier.
Token stores a kind, value, and line number. Its representation displays all three fields.
